messages:
Ava (CS): Heads up — Umbra's production embeddings spend spiked ~3.2x overnight. Hit the 90% budget alert and AE flagged renewal risk. Need a short mitigation plan for the QBR on Friday. @Priya can you confirm renewal timing?

Priya (AE): Saw the alert, I'm on a call with their CTO. Renewal in ~30 days. They're running high-recall searches and pushed a larger batch of backfills. They might negotiate unit price if burn continues.

Luke (FinOps): Pulling 7d token heatmap now. Quick query I ran: `SELECT date, tokens FROM usage WHERE account='umbra' ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 7;` results incoming.

Luke (FinOps): TL;DR — embeddings up 320% vs last week, generation calls down ~10%. Avg seq length for embed requests ~8k tokens.

Diego (Support): Noticed ~15 timeouts tied to v2-embed endpoint in logs. Possible batching misconfig + KV cache misses. Opening ticket and will reference runtime runbook.

Ava (CS): Proposed immediate mitigations: 1) soft throttle at 85% baseline for embeddings (no hard cut), 2) enable prefix/KV caching for repeat queries, 3) offer 1 week of credits on next invoice, 4) prep a focused "cost optimization" slide for QBR. Thoughts?

Priya (AE): +1 on credits, will ask legal/finance for fast approval. Also recommend offering a short Dedicated trial to prove lower unit cost and stable latency.

Luke (FinOps): Approving 1 week credits capped at $15k. For Dedicated trial need commitment terms — propose 3-month reserved with X% discount. I'll draft offer text.

CostOps Bot: Budget alert triggered for account=umbra at 90%. Action configured: notify=#customer-success, soft-throttle. Alert timestamp: 2139992000.

Ava (CS): Diego — what's batch_size in prod for embeddings? If it's 1 we should bump to 8 for now.

Diego (Support): Confirmed batch_size=1 in prod. Rolling canary change to 8 now (eng-run). ETA ~15m. Monitoring error rates.

Priya (AE): Umbra is open to a 1-week credit and 30–45 min enablement call focused on batching, caching, and prompt patterns. Can host Wed 10am PT — I'll send invite.

Ava (CS): Action items (due EOD Thu): 1) Luke: 2-slide cost delta + 3mo spend forecast; 2) Diego: validate batching fix + KV caching behavior; 3) Priya: schedule enablement and confirm renewal timeline; 4) CS: assemble QBR cost slide with recommended commitments.

Luke (FinOps): Working on the 3mo projection. Early estimate: Dedicated + quantization could reduce embed unit cost ~30% given current profile. Will attach numbers shortly.

Diego (Support): Canary deploy complete — timeouts down from 15 -> 2 in the last 10m. CPU utilization rose but within headroom. Observability dashboard: http://dash.internal/umbra/usage (internal).

Ava (CS): Good. Priya please ping when invite sent. Tagging @exec-ops for credit approval.

Priya (AE): Invite sent to Umbra + internal. Draft credit approval doc: https://internal/docs/umbra-credit-draft — reviewers please check: @Luke, @Finance.

Luke (FinOps): Reviewed and approved the $15k one-week credit. I'll finalize the numbers and add to the QBR deck.

Ava (CS): Closing notes for thread: highlight temporary credits, batching fix, Dedicated recommendation & forecast. If spike recurs we'll escalate to reserved capacity pool. Thanks team :thumbsup:

Diego (Support): I'll keep the ticket open and post error rate and latency updates here.

Priya (AE): I'll surface the Dedicated trial offer during the QBR and include a migration checklist.

Ava (CS): Perfect — see you all on the QBR prep sync tomorrow.
